answer: The tide graph is validated at intake and the fable frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and comet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 232 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
